rationale.text: The document holds no title element anywhere: not in head, not in body, not in a template, a shadow tree or noscript text. The test asks whether the page has a page title given by the title tag, and the glossary defines the page title as the content of that tag; with no such tag the page has none under any reading. The custom check faults the page (its step 2) through a link whose fault means failure, so the finding is failed at fail_only and at full. axe's document-title also faults, as evidence only.

citations.quote: Chaque page web a-t-elle un titre de page (balise `<title>`) ?
Contenu de la balise <title> d’une page web
Retrouver dans le document le titre structuré au moyen d’un élément `<title>` ;
